about.heading: What I bring to a team
pillar.1.title: I think about the whole system, not just the code
pillar.1.body: I have worked on backends, databases, message queues and frontend integrations, and I'm also interested in CI/CD and cloud deployment. I care not only that a feature works, but also about its security, how it behaves when things fail, and whether it stays maintainable in a real environment.
pillar.2.title: I don't use AI just to write code
pillar.2.body: Before I start coding I plan the work and try to pin down the requirements. I don't use AI-generated code I don't understand; I test it, verify it and change it when needed.
pillar.3.title: I learn and solve problems by understanding them
pillar.3.body: When I run into a problem, I look into the cause instead of reaching for a quick temporary fix, and I weigh different approaches. When I learn a new technology, I focus not only on how it works but also on why it came about and which problems it solves.
pillar.4.title: I build solutions that improve efficiency
pillar.4.body: I care about Python tools that automate repetitive work and solutions that make development processes easier. My goal is not only to finish my own tasks but also to make my teammates' work easier and the team's technical workflows more efficient.
pillar.5.title: I take responsibility and value working together
pillar.5.body: I focus on finishing the work I take on correctly and sustainably, not just on completing it. I value sharing my technical decisions, taking feedback on board, and developing shared solutions by exchanging knowledge with my teammates.
